name: collex-inquiries
description: Collex Inquiries — Field Investigation / Field Verification Management System (Web Platform)

scripts.start:local: npm run build --prefix server && concurrently -n client,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run client" "npm run server" "npm run worker"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
